issue_description: Fix RequestValidationError when passing nested Pydantic models with custom validators. Currently raises 500 Internal Server Error instead of 422 Unprocessable Entity when validation fails inside union types.
hints_text: Check fastapi/routing.py serialize_response and parse_body functions.
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_validation.py b/tests/test_validation.py
--- a/tests/test_validation.py
+++ b/tests/test_validation.py
@@ -10,6 +10,12 @@
+def test_nested_union_validation():
+    response = client.post('/nested', json={'item': 'invalid'})
+    assert response.status_code == 422
